port.description: Probe port. Used by HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, and gRPC probes.

path.description: Request path used by HTTP and HTTPS probes.

httpHeaders.description: HTTP headers sent with HTTP and HTTPS probes.

successThreshold.description: Successful probes in a row before the probe succeeds.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Failed probes in a row before the probe fails.

exec.description: Legacy exec handler set by `stable/dashy`, `stable/mongodb`, `stable/nginx-proxy-manager`, and `stable/whisparr`. The probe templates ignore it. Use top-level `command` with `type: exec` instead.

httpGet.description: Legacy HTTP handler set by `stable/miniflux`, `stable/nullserv`, and `stable/nzbhydra`. The probe templates ignore it. Use top-level `type`, `path`, and `port` instead.

command.description: Define the command to run. Only applies when `type: exec`

custom.description: Legacy probe flag set by `stable/dashy`, `stable/miniflux`, `stable/mongodb`, `stable/nginx-proxy-manager`, `stable/nullserv`, `stable/nzbhydra`, and `stable/whisparr`. The probe templates ignore it. Use `type` with `path`, `port`, or `command` instead.

exec.description: Legacy exec handler set by `stable/rtorrent-rutorrent`. The probe templates ignore it. Use `type: exec` with `command` instead.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Legacy top-level delay set by `stable/docker`. The probe templates ignore it. Use `spec.initialDelaySeconds` instead.

failureThreshold.description: Legacy top-level failure threshold set by the `stable/sdtd` startup probe. The probe templates ignore it. Use `spec.failureThreshold` instead.
